arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Lucky Hit: {/c}Up to a {c_random}{SF_0}%{/c} chance to inflict {c_important}Hex of Flames{/c}. 

When you damage an enemy afflicted with {c_important}Hex of Flames{/c}, you deal {c_number}[SF_2]{/c} additional Fire damage to them. {if:SF_10}If activated by a Critical Strike, the Fire damage explodes in an area instead.{/if}
Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
If you Critically Strike an enemy afflicted with {c_important}Hex of Flames{/c}, the Fire damage explodes in an area instead.
